svg.title: Commissioning the servo
svg.desc: When the encoder freezes, the controller gives no torque from 3.04 to 3.20 seconds and the loaded shaft drops; after the restart the torque builds up from zero, the shaft falls to −0.155 radians at 3.72 seconds and is back within 0.02 radians from 6 seconds. The largest move requests at most 8.12 newton-metres, far from the 20 newton-metre limit.
svg.text: Commissioning the servo: a measurement fault and the largest move
Control Studio validation runs of the candidate on the actual ST · 1.962 N·m load · numbers answer the predictions
